title: Multi-tab state coordination: Use an explicit message origin and monotonic revision gate when synchronizing selected client preferences between tabs; document conflict limitations.
description: A complete Zustand 5 state-boundaries lesson using actual vanilla stores, targeted subscriptions and safe client state ownership, including a red starter and offline regression tests.
objectives: Use an explicit message origin and monotonic revision gate when synchronizing selected client preferences between tabs; document conflict limitations.
